Kasado na ang traffic management plan ng MMDA sa para sa Trillion Peso March Rally Protest sa Linggo, Nobyembre 30, na gaganapin sa Luneta sa Maynila at EDSA People Power Monument sa Quezon City. 

Sa pulong nina MMDA General Manager Usec. Procopio Lipana at traffic enforcement unit heads, tinalakay ang pag-asiste ng ahensiya sa mangyayaring rally sa Linggo. 

I-a-activate din ang Emergency Operations Center (EOC) ng MMDA upang i-monitor ang sitwasyon ng trapiko sa paligid ng mga lokasyon ng malawakang kilos-protesta laban sa korapsyon.

data.text:
NO MAJOR ROAD CLOSURES FOR SUPAKK PRAYER RALLY AND PEACE MARCH

LOOK: The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) has issued a traffic advisory ahead of the Synergized Prayer Rally / Peace March organized by the Sugbuanong Pakigbisug Kontra Kurapsyon (SuPaKK) on Sunday, Nov. 30, 2025, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

The event is expected to draw a large crowd, with a Youth March at 9 a.m., followed by a Procession at 3 p.m. The route will begin at the Sto. Niño Pilgrim Center and end at Fuente Osmeña Circle.

No major road closures are planned, but CCTO says temporary closures may be implemented as needed to manage the flow of participants and ensure safety. Minor traffic delays are expected along affected roads throughout the day.

Motorists are advised to take alternate routes. Traffic personnel will be deployed to manage the situation and assist road users. | 📸 Cebu City Transportation Office via Lyle Andales #CDNDigital

For more news about Cebu and beyond, visit https://t.co/nWCmctdteW
